Package org.apache.beam.sdk

Class CompositePipeline

java.lang.Object
org.apache.beam.sdk.Pipeline
org.apache.beam.sdk.CompositePipeline
@Internal public final class CompositePipeline extends Pipeline
For internal use only; no backwards-compatibility guarantees.

A read-only Pipeline that presents several independently constructed member pipelines as one graph, so that a runner can translate and execute them together as a single job.

Only the two operations runners use to translate a pipeline are composed: traverseTopologically(org.apache.beam.sdk.Pipeline.PipelineVisitor) visits every member in turn, and replaceAll(java.util.List<org.apache.beam.sdk.runners.PTransformOverride>) applies the runner's overrides to every member. Everything else is the composite's own: Pipeline.getOptions() are the options passed to the constructor (member options are ignored), the coder and schema registries are fresh and empty, and transforms cannot be applied to it.

Visitor contract: traverseTopologically(org.apache.beam.sdk.Pipeline.PipelineVisitor) invokes Pipeline.PipelineVisitor.enterPipeline(org.apache.beam.sdk.Pipeline) and Pipeline.PipelineVisitor.leavePipeline(org.apache.beam.sdk.Pipeline) once per member, each time with that member, and visits the member's root node in between; it never passes the composite itself to the visitor. Consequently Pipeline.PipelineVisitor.Defaults.getPipeline() always yields the member that owns the node being visited, which is what visitors needing a member's state (for example its Pipeline.getCoderRegistry()) should use. Visitors that assume a single enterPipeline/root-node visit per traversal must instead be applied to each member in getMemberPipelines().

Members must have pairwise distinct top-level transform names (and therefore distinct full names throughout, since every nested name and PCollection name is derived from its enclosing transform's); this is checked at construction. The simplest way to guarantee it is to give each member a unique root name via TransformHierarchy.setRootName(java.lang.String) before applying any transform.

    • traverseTopologically

      public void traverseTopologically(Pipeline.PipelineVisitor visitor)
      Description copied from class: Pipeline
      For internal use only; no backwards-compatibility guarantees.

      Invokes the PipelineVisitor's Pipeline.PipelineVisitor.visitPrimitiveTransform(org.apache.beam.sdk.runners.TransformHierarchy.Node) and Pipeline.PipelineVisitor.visitValue(org.apache.beam.sdk.values.PValue, org.apache.beam.sdk.runners.TransformHierarchy.Node) operations on each of this Pipeline's transform and value nodes, in forward topological order.

      Traversal of the Pipeline causes PTransforms and PValues owned by the Pipeline to be marked as finished, at which point they may no longer be modified.

      Typically invoked by PipelineRunner subclasses.

      Overrides:
      traverseTopologically in class Pipeline

      Description copied from class: Pipeline

    • apply

      public <OutputT extends POutput> OutputT apply(String name, PTransform<? super PBegin,OutputT> root)
      Description copied from class: Pipeline
      Adds a root PTransform, such as Read or Create, to this Pipeline.

      The node in the Pipeline graph will use the provided name. This name is used in various places, including the monitoring UI, logging, and to stably identify this node in the Pipeline graph upon update.

      Alias for begin().apply(name, root).

      Overrides:

      Throws:
